newsitem.title: USA: Cooperative Computing extends Triad offer.
newsitem.headline: Cooperative Computing extends Triad offer.

text.p: Cooperative Computing Inc and its affiliate CCI Acquisition Corp said they had extended their tender offer to acquire the common shares of Triad Systems Corp to 10 a.m., Feb 7 at a price of $9.25 a share.
The companies said in a Friday statement the offer was scheduled to expire at 10 a.m. EST on Jan 27. The terms of the extended tender offer are identical to those in the original offer.
As of Jan 24, 14.9 million shares, or 84.2 percent of those issued and outstanding, had been validly tendered and not withdrawn, the statement said.

The companies said they were extending the offer to provide more time "to resolve certain issues raised by the Federal Trade Commission in connection with the FTC's review of the transaction under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act."
